title: GhostbustersANTI-ESP
description: A hidden base should be discovered through exploration, not exploits. Ghostbusters-ESP provides a covenant of protection, the final solution to espers: fighting ghosts with ghosts.
body:
A passive anti ESP plugin for both entities and fake decoy bases, built for performance first. Instead of chasing perfect entity culling and risking visual glitches, GhostBustersAnti-ESP uses straightforward line of sight occlusion to hide players and mobs behind solid blocks. No fallback distance gimmicks, no entities popping in and out awkwardly. It just works the way line of sight should.

On top of that, GhostBusters ships with a full honeypot system. Currently, over 35 unique fake base designs are randomly placed underground around each player, fully hidden behind real terrain so legitimate players never see them in caves. If someone with X ray or ESP mines toward one expecting loot, they just hit stone. The fake structure clears and a new one gets placed elsewhere, completely seamless, with zero impact on players who aren't cheating.

Every detection layer in this plugin is grounded in real geometry rather than client side trust, which means there's nothing for a cheat client to spoof or bypass. Combine this with a basic movement based anticheat and ESP becomes functionally useless on the server, since the anti esp is, on a fundamental level, unbypassable.

Lightweight, configurable, and built to scale with high player counts without tanking your tick rate.


Commands list: 
/gbesp toggle entities — turn entity LOS hiding on or off

/gbesp toggle honeypots — turn the fake decoy base system on or off

/gbesp status — view current on/off state of both systems

/gbesp reload — reload config.yml without restarting the server
